evidence: AC5: 'The criteria guide is regenerated and mentions both rules (checked: regen command output committed; guide text asserts)'
registry.py docstring: 'The DET floor (P1–P9) is NOT in this file — it is the ``exec=DET`` tier in :mod:`.det_floor`'
regenerate_criteria_guide() at line 609: `criteria = sorted(load_criteria(repo_root=''), key=lambda c: c['id'])` — only loads CANONICAL_LLM criteria
validate_criteria_guide() at line 651 checks parity against CANONICAL_LLM, not DET checks
Plan scope: 'src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, tests/llm/test_det_floor_clarity.py, docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md' — registry.py not in scope
findings.finding: The plan's AC5 asserts 'The criteria guide is regenerated and mentions both rules (checked: regen command output committed; guide text asserts)', but `regenerate_criteria_guide()` in `registry.py` generates the guide exclusively from `CANONICAL_LLM` — which contains only LLM-tier criteria. The registry module's own docstring states 'The DET floor (P1–P9) is NOT in this file.' The new R1 check and the promoted R2 check are DET-tier additions to `det_floor.py`, so they will not appear in the regenerated guide unless `CANONICAL_LLM` is extended or the guide generator is separately updated — neither of which is in scope.
scenarios: Developer runs `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide` as instructed; the guide is regenerated but contains no R1/R2 sections because those are DET-tier checks not in CANONICAL_LLM.

AC5's unit-test assertion 'guide text asserts' would require the guide to be hand-edited (which the file header forbids) or the guide generator/CANONICAL_LLM to be extended — work not captured in scope.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) add `registry.py` and `criteria_routing.json` to scope, register R1/R2 as DET-tier entries in `CANONICAL_LLM` and the routing index so regen picks them up; or (b) revise AC5 to 'The DET floor section of the criteria guide (hand-authored or separately generated) is updated to document R1 and R2' and add that authoring step to the plan.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Realign the leaf to advisory posture (matching the parent epic 6982's advisory-first mandate for new DET additions), OR update the parent epic 6982's plan to document the operator-approved blocking promotion and re-review the parent before re-reviewing this leaf.

findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) change the plan's posture to advisory with a note that blocking promotion follows the standing dogfood recorder protocol documented in docs/plan-review-gate.md, or (b) reopen epic 6982, amend its plan to include an explicit blocking-promotion path for backtest-validated DET floor additions, obtain a new plan-review attestation on the parent, and then re-review this leaf.
